description: Backend solution scaffold + full DAL layer. Create Shop.sln and the four net7.0 projects (Shop.DAL/Shop.BLL/Shop.SL/Shop.Api) with correct project references and exact package pins, config files, locked port, and a minimal compiling Program.cs; then build out Shop.DAL completely: entities+enums, ViewModels, ShopContext with full OnModelCreating config, and the HasData demo seed. Reaches a compiling solution. Depends on nothing. Ground every type in design.md §2.1-§2.5 and §2.15.
steps: From repo root create the solution and projects: `dotnet new sln -n Shop`; `dotnet new classlib -o src/Shop.DAL -f net7.0`; `dotnet new classlib -o src/Shop.BLL -f net7.0`; `dotnet new classlib -o src/Shop.SL -f net7.0`; `dotnet new webapi -o src/Shop.Api -f net7.0`; add all four to the sln. Delete the default Class1.cs/WeatherForecast template files.
Set project references: Shop.BLL -> Shop.DAL; Shop.SL -> Shop.DAL; Shop.Api -> Shop.BLL, Shop.SL, Shop.DAL.

Add exact packages: Shop.DAL -> Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 7.0.20, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Relational 7.0.20, Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL 7.0.20. Shop.BLL -> Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 7.0.20, Microsoft.Extensions.Identity.Core 7.0.20. Shop.SL -> System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt 7.x, Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens 7.x. Shop.Api -> Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design 7.0.20, Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL 7.0.20, AutoMapper 12.0.0 (EXACT), AutoMapper.Extensions.Microsoft.DependencyInjection 12.0.0 (EXACT), Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer 7.0.20, Swashbuckle.AspNetCore 6.5.0. If a 7.0.20 patch is unavailable on restore, use the latest available 7.0.x patch but never 8.x.

In Shop.DAL.csproj and Shop.BLL.csproj set <GenerateDocumentationFile>true</GenerateDocumentationFile>; do NOT set TreatWarningsAsErrors (CS1591 stays a warning). Next to the AutoMapper references in Shop.Api.csproj add an XML comment: '12.x only - 13 removes the DI extension used by AddAutoMapper(Type)'.

Create src/Shop.Api/appsettings.json with ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection='Host=localhost;Port=5432;Database=online_shopping;Username=postgres;Password=postgres' and a Jwt section {SecretKey (>=32 chars placeholder), Issuer='OnlineShopping', Audience='OnlineShoppingClient', ExpiryMinutes=120}. Create appsettings.Development.json overriding Jwt:SecretKey + logging. Create src/Shop.Api/Properties/launchSettings.json with Kestrel applicationUrl=http://localhost:5000 (single HTTP profile, no 5001 HTTPS redirect).

Write a minimal compiling src/Shop.Api/Program.cs (builder, AddControllers, AddEndpointsApiExplorer, AddSwaggerGen, app.MapControllers, Swagger in Development) with NO DI for repos/services yet (that lands in FEAT-003). Remove the template WeatherForecast controller/model.

Create entities in src/Shop.DAL/Models/ with `public int Id { get; set; }` PascalCase keys + nav props per design.md §2.3: Category, Product, ProductVariant, ProductImage, InventoryItem (VariantId nullable), Customer, Cart, CartItem, Order (OrderNumber, nullable CustomerId, GuestEmail/GuestName, Status, Subtotal/DiscountTotal/Tax/ShippingTotal/Total decimals, PlacedAt), OrderItem (ProductNameSnapshot/UnitPrice/Quantity/LineTotal), Discount, AdminUser (plain entity, PasswordHash only, no hashing logic), Role. Add enums OrderStatus{Pending,Paid,Processing,Shipped,Delivered,Cancelled} and DiscountType{Percentage,Fixed}. Seedable entities carry an IsDemoData bool. XML-doc every public type/member.

Create ViewModels in src/Shop.DAL/ViewModels/ per design.md §2.4: generic PagedResultVM<T>(Items,TotalCount,Page,PageSize), ProductListItemVM, ProductDetailVM, CategoryVM, ProductVariantVM, ProductImageVM, CartLineRequest, CartVM, CartLineVM, PlaceOrderRequest, OrderConfirmationResponse, OrderTrackingVM, OrderItemVM, AuthenticateRequest, AuthenticateResponse, TokenVM{Token,Expires}, ProductUpsertRequest, BulkProductUpdateRequest(ProductIds,NewPrice?,IsActive?,CategoryId?), LowStockItemVM(ProductId,ProductName,VariantId?,VariantLabel?,QuantityOnHand,LowStockThreshold), AdminOrderListItemVM, UpdateOrderStatusRequest(Status), DiscountVM, DiscountUpsertRequest, CustomerListItemVM, SalesOverviewVM(TotalRevenue,OrderCount,AverageOrderValue,LowStockCount,TopProducts), TopProductVM. Add DataAnnotations per design.md §2.14 (EmailAddress, StringLength, Range, Required). XML-doc every public type/member.

Create src/Shop.DAL/Data/ShopContext.cs: ShopContext : DbContext with ctor DbContextOptions<ShopContext>, one DbSet<> per entity, OnModelCreating configuring keys/relationships, unique indexes on Order.OrderNumber, Category.Slug, Product.Slug, AdminUser.Username, Discount.Code, decimal HasPrecision(18,2) on money columns, enum HasConversion<int>(), then call ShopContextSeed.Seed(modelBuilder). XML-doc.

Create src/Shop.DAL/Data/ShopContextSeed.cs using HasData per design.md §2.15 discipline: constant literal PKs in disjoint ranges (categories 1-9, products 100s, variants 1000s, images 2000s, inventory 3000s, orders 5000s, order-items 6000s, discounts/roles/admin small ints); FK scalars only (NO navigation graphs); fixed new DateTime(2024,...,DateTimeKind.Utc) literals (NEVER DateTime.UtcNow); enums as fixed backing ints; AdminUser.PasswordHash as a precomputed constant string (document the demo plaintext in README later, NOT a hasher call here); every row IsDemoData=true. Seed ~4 categories, ~12 products (1-3 variants + 1-2 images each), inventory rows with >=1 at/below LowStockThreshold, Role=Admin + one AdminUser, ~3 orders (>=1 placed, >=1 using a low-stock product), ~2 discounts.
acceptance_criteria: Shop.sln references exactly four projects (Shop.DAL, Shop.BLL, Shop.SL, Shop.Api), each with <TargetFramework>net7.0</TargetFramework>.
Shop.DAL contains all 13 entities + 2 enums with int Id keys, all ViewModels, ShopContext with a DbSet per entity and OnModelCreating config, and ShopContextSeed with HasData.
Seed includes >=1 inventory row at/below LowStockThreshold and >=1 placed order; every seeded row has IsDemoData=true.
GenerateDocumentationFile is true on Shop.DAL and Shop.BLL; AutoMapper packages are pinned to exactly 12.0.0 with the explanatory csproj comment.
appsettings.json has the exact DefaultConnection + Jwt section; launchSettings.json pins applicationUrl to http://localhost:5000.
`dotnet build Shop.sln` completes with 0 errors and no live database.
verification: Run `dotnet build Shop.sln` from repo root and confirm 0 errors (CS1591 warnings are acceptable).
Confirm no project targets net8.0/net9.0 (grep TargetFramework across src/*/*.csproj shows only net7.0).
findings:
Build verified: `dotnet build Shop.sln` => Build succeeded, 0 Warnings, 0 Errors, no live DB (MSBuild 17.6.8, SDK 7.0.306). All 4 projects target net7.0.

PACKAGE PATCH VERSIONS (resolved on this machine's feed):
- Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 7.0.20, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Relational 7.0.20, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design 7.0.20: available, used as pinned.
- Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL: 7.0.20 is NOT published; latest 7.0.x is 7.0.18 (used in Shop.DAL and Shop.Api). Never 8.x (needs absent .NET 8 runtime). Available 7.0.x patches: 7.0.0/.1/.3/.4/.11/.18.
- Microsoft.Extensions.Identity.Core 7.0.20 (Shop.BLL).
- System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt 7.0.3 + Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens 7.0.3 (Shop.SL).
- AutoMapper 12.0.0 + AutoMapper.Extensions.Microsoft.DependencyInjection 12.0.0 (EXACT, Shop.Api), with the 12.x-only csproj comment.
- Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer 7.0.20, Swashbuckle.AspNetCore 6.5.0 (Shop.Api).
- Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi reference removed from Shop.Api (not needed; replaced by explicit pins).

DEMO ADMIN CREDENTIALS: username='admin', plaintext password='Admin@12345'. Precomputed Identity (PasswordHasherCompatibilityMode.IdentityV3) PasswordHash constant stored as ShopContextSeed.AdminPasswordHash. Plaintext stored as ShopContextSeed.AdminDemoPassword. Login verify path (FEAT later) MUST use PasswordHasher with CompatibilityMode=IdentityV3 so the seeded hash verifies. NOTE: PasswordHasher uses a random salt, so re-hashing yields a different string each time; the constant hash is one valid hash of 'Admin@12345' and must NOT be regenerated.

SEED PK RANGES (disjoint, HasData, every row IsDemoData=true incl. OrderItem which gained an IsDemoData bool):
- Role: Id 1 (Admin). AdminUser: Id 1 (admin, RoleId=1).
- Category: 1-4 (1 Apparel, 2 Footwear, 3 Accessories, 4 Electronics).
- Product: 101-112 (12 products).
- ProductVariant: 1001-1012 (products 101,102,104,105,110 have variants; 103,106,107,108,109,111,112 are variant-less).
- ProductImage: 2001-2013.
- InventoryItem: 3001-3019. LOW-STOCK rows (QtyOnHand<=LowStockThreshold): 3002 (variant 1002, qty3/thr5), 3005 (variant 1005, qty2/thr5), 3009 (variant 1008, qty5/thr5 at threshold), 3015 (product 109, qty4/thr5). Variant-level when variants exist else product-level (VariantId null).
- Customer: 1 (Jordan Rivera), 2 (Sam Taylor).
- Discount: 1 WELCOME10 (Percentage 10), 2 SAVE5 (Fixed 5).
- Order: 5001 (ORD-20240210-A1B2C3, CustomerId=1, Paid, uses low-stock variant 1002), 5002 (ORD-20240215-D4E5F6, guest, Delivered), 5003 (ORD-20240301-G7H8J9, CustomerId=2, Pending).
- OrderItem: 6001-6004.
Fixed DateTime literals (UTC) used throughout; never DateTime.UtcNow.

ENTITY NAMES (Shop.DAL.Models): Category, Product, ProductVariant, ProductImage, InventoryItem, Customer, Cart, CartItem, Order, OrderItem, Discount, AdminUser, Role. Enums: OrderStatus{Pending=0,Paid=1,Processing=2,Shipped=3,Delivered=4,Cancelled=5}, DiscountType{Percentage=0,Fixed=1} (both HasConversion<int>). DbContext: ShopContext (DbSets: Categories, Products, ProductVariants, ProductImages, InventoryItems, Customers, Carts, CartItems, Orders, OrderItems, Discounts, AdminUsers, Roles). Unique indexes: Order.OrderNumber, Category.Slug, Product.Slug, AdminUser.Username, Discount.Code. Money columns HasPrecision(18,2).

VIEWMODEL NAMES (Shop.DAL.ViewModels): PagedResultVM<T>, ProductListItemVM, ProductDetailVM, CategoryVM, ProductVariantVM, ProductImageVM, CartLineRequest, CartVM, CartLineVM, PlaceOrderRequest, OrderConfirmationResponse, OrderTrackingVM, OrderItemVM, AuthenticateRequest, AuthenticateResponse, TokenVM, ProductUpsertRequest, BulkProductUpdateRequest, LowStockItemVM, AdminOrderListItemVM, UpdateOrderStatusRequest, DiscountVM, DiscountUpsertRequest, CustomerListItemVM, SalesOverviewVM, TopProductVM.

SOLUTION/CONFIG: Shop.sln (root) references src/Shop.DAL, src/Shop.BLL, src/Shop.SL, src/Shop.Api. Refs: BLL->DAL; SL->DAL; Api->BLL,SL,DAL. GenerateDocumentationFile=true on DAL+BLL (no CS1591 warnings because every public member is XML-doc'd). appsettings.json: DefaultConnection + Jwt{SecretKey,Issuer=OnlineShopping,Audience=OnlineShoppingClient,ExpiryMinutes=120}. appsettings.Development.json overrides Jwt:SecretKey + logging. launchSettings.json single HTTP profile applicationUrl=http://localhost:5000. Program.cs minimal (AddControllers/Swagger/MapControllers, Swagger in Dev, UseAuthorization); NO repo/service DI yet (FEAT-003). A .gitignore (bin/obj/node_modules) was added and `git init` created the repo on branch 'master' (no repo existed before).
